context:
Goal: the native package card looks like the web card, and the seller name stays selectable and on one line.
Problem: the fix that passes the accessibility audit lets the 15pt seller shrink to 7.5pt, below your 10px type floor. The round-3 reviewer found the audit's "Text clipped" cause unmeasured: "Alpha Cards" fails at 90% though it fills only 82pt of a 238pt column. So the shrink hides an audit quirk rather than fixing it.
Based on: the round-3 reviewer's report and the builder's logs (read, 02:48); PackagesView.swift:70 sets Cochin 15 with a 0.5 floor (read).
Meanwhile: step 3 has passed review round 3 and waits only on this and the design review.

options.how: Batch step 3 with the shrink; file a debt to measure the audit cause.
options.label: Ship cards now, 0.5 floor
options.lose: Sellers of about 37-50 characters read below 10pt until a later lane fixes it.

options.how: A new lane sets the floor to 0.67 and measures the audit at each size before batching.
options.label: Floor at 10pt first
options.lose: Step 3 waits, and 0.67 may still fail the audit.

options.gain: Exact match with the web type.
options.how: The seller becomes plain text at full size.
options.label: Drop seller selection
options.lose: Reverses your ruling that the seller stays selectable.

title: Native cards: the seller shrink goes below your 10px type floor
why: Gets cards on the phone now; only long sellers are affected, and the debt names the fix.
